resources.string: These presentation choices apply to this app and its open windows. They do not change device settings or the other Cloudy app.
Native captions, launch screens and the keyboard remain controlled by Android. Text keeps the system font scale; pointer density changes spacing and nominal control sizes.
Controls retain their native minimum interactive targets and may grow for scaled text.

Terminal sessions follow the MobaXterm-style defaults: selection copies immediately, Shift+Insert pastes, and Ctrl+wheel adjusts font size. The interactive terminal is not integrated yet; this right-click choice is saved now and applies when it is.
The choice was saved for this app.

Some saved choices are invalid. Appearance uses System, density uses Comfortable and terminal right-click uses Paste where needed. Select a choice to replace its invalid saved value. Your other choices are kept.
Your current choices are shown, but saving could not be confirmed. Refresh cannot confirm that they were saved. Select a choice again to retry saving.
